value.rationale: This classifies the simplicial double for an entire natural infinite class of simplicial three-spheres, supplying a structural connectivity-preserving stacking lemma and exact integral loops increase. General doubling theory does not imply connectedness in this dimension; cyclic three-sphere boundaries can have disconnected doubles. The main value is the local structural classification, not only Euler subtraction.
